# Copilot instructions for this portfolio project

- This repository is a Vite + React + TypeScript portfolio site.
- Preserve the existing visual style: modern, minimal, responsive, and lightweight.
- Prefer small, focused components in src/components and page-level composition in src/pages.
- Keep content professional and concise; avoid adding unnecessary backend code or state management.
- When editing existing work, preserve the current routing structure and existing data-driven content in src/data.
- Use the existing UI primitives in src/components/ui where possible.
- Prefer TypeScript typing and accessibility-friendly markup.
- Do not introduce new dependencies unless clearly justified.
